name: Four Seasons Hotel New York Downtown
positioning: Contemporary Lower Manhattan hotel at 27 Barclay Street, in a skyscraper designed by Robert A.M. Stern, home to CUT by Wolfgang Puck
best_for: Travelers who want a Lower Manhattan base in Tribeca near the World Trade Center
Guests who want a steakhouse and a spa with a lap pool in the same building

facts.text: The hotel is at 27 Barclay Street.
The hotel occupies 24 stories of an 82-storey building.
The building was designed by architect Robert A.M. Stern.
The hotel interiors are by Yabu Pushelberg.
The hotel is located next to the Woolworth Building.
CUT by Wolfgang Puck is located just off the hotel lobby.
The spa has 7 treatment rooms, including a Couple's Suite.
The hotel has a 75 ft indoor lap pool.

highlights.text: CUT is the first Manhattan establishment from chef Wolfgang Puck.
The 75-foot lap pool is flooded with natural light.
The spa offers more than 30 treatments.
Three suites have their own private terrace.
Guests can borrow Biria bikes during their stay.

considerations.text: The pool is open 6:00 am to 9:00 pm.
Hotel parking is USD 115 for a 24 hour period for regular vehicles.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflects the luxury positioning.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
